collection.title: Peugeot Rifter 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot Rifter 2018 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 17" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The BOSCH recommendation is 26" & 17". This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear blades available for this model, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
